title: Gaia v27.5.0-rc0 Upgrade
summary:
# Summary

- The `v27.5.0` upgrade bumps the following versions:
    - `ibc-go` v10.6.0 → v10.7.0
- If the proposal passes, validators will be required to update the Cosmos Hub binary at the specified upgrade height.

# Release Details

- The release can be found [here](https://github.com/cosmos/gaia/releases/tag/v27.5.0-rc0).
- The changelog can be found [here](https://github.com/cosmos/gaia/blob/v27.5.0-rc0/CHANGELOG.md).

**This upgrade is state-breaking and mandatory once the on-chain vote passes and the upgrade height is reached.**
